industry_constraint.classification: shenwan L1 (31 industries) + UNMAPPED bucket (2/2933 composite candidates)
industry_constraint.rule: members per L1 industry (incl. UNMAPPED) <= 2; ENTRIES ONLY (skip candidate if its industry already has 2 seated members); incumbents never force-exited on industry grounds; unfilled seats = rule-compliant cash (monthly stats logged)
industry_constraint.lookahead_disclosure: single-snapshot 2026 classification applied to 2015-2020; industry membership is sticky but SW-2021 reclassifications misassign some historical months; constraint-purpose (diversification) usage, second-order; carried into any val claim

stock_sleeve.composite_source: F3R1 frozen outputs verbatim: F3-EW_composite.parquet / F3-ICW_composite.parquet
stock_sleeve.weight_rule: w_T = e_T * (0.06 / 0.90); risk-on per-name 0.06 (sleeve 60%), risk-off 0.02667 (26.67%); e_T = R16 T200-40 verbatim; idle cash in risk-off months disclosed
stock_sleeve.intents: entry -> buy(target_weight=w_T); exit -> sell risk full; continuing -> monthly reduce-to-target; no top-up primitive (S5 seam)
stock_sleeve.stock_semantics: am/pm, T+1, integer lots, STOCK_FEE_SCHEDULE, real stk_limit
